adjustments.scenario: VT Penta Bounce Entry S5 Speed

beforeOtherFocus.Diagonal: Diagonal path. Straight line, no curve.
beforeOtherFocus.Horizontal: Horizontal only. Flat line, time switch.
beforeOtherFocus.Micro Pressure: Small, rushed. Micro held under pace.
beforeOtherFocus.Speed: Big, close. Flick lands direct. Pace.
beforeOtherFocus.Wide Pressure: Wide wall, rushed. Big flick, no pause.
beforeOtherFocus.Wide wall: Wide angles. Big flick, next in peripheral.
beforeOtherFocus.Evo Gallery: Hold the pace as the targets multiply.
beforeOtherFocus.Vox Gallery: Pick your route through the gallery.
beforeOtherFocus.Reload Rush: Chain the clears. Keep the rhythm alive.
beforeOtherFocus.Micro Chain: Find a three-target beat and build speed.
beforeOtherFocus.Pasu: Read the drift. Click on confirmation.
beforeOtherFocus.PipeClick: Meet the path. Confirm the shot.
beforeOtherFocus.Bounce: Read the full bounce, not just the apex.
beforeOtherFocus.Angelic: Read horizontal movement through the shot.
beforeOtherFocus.Pasu Sequence: Stay with each target for all three clicks.
beforeOtherFocus.Popcorn: Follow the arc into a clean click.
beforeOtherFocus.Floating Gallery: Catch the next head as it drifts into view.
beforeOtherFocus.Sky Gallery: Hop between layers. Catch each passing dot.
beforeOtherFocus.Wave Click: Ride the wave from shot to shot.
beforeOtherFocus.Smoothbot: Match the long arc with steady contact.
beforeOtherFocus.Centering: Settle into the strafe. Match its speed.
beforeOtherFocus.PreciseTrack: Recover cleanly. Settle back on target.
beforeOtherFocus.Whisphere: Match the curve and its changing speed.
beforeOtherFocus.Vertical Control: Stay connected through the rise and fall.
beforeOtherFocus.DVD Chase: Follow the bounce all the way to the corner.
beforeOtherFocus.Flower Chase: Trace the flower. Stay with each little turn.
beforeOtherFocus.Sphere Cruise: Cruise with the dot as it circles you.
beforeOtherFocus.Waldo Track: Stay on it, not near it.
beforeOtherFocus.Ground Plaza: Read each strafe. React after the turn.
beforeOtherFocus.Air Reading: Follow the aerial change without guessing.
beforeOtherFocus.Air Angelic: Recover from the turn, then match speed.
beforeOtherFocus.Strafe Gallery: Read the next strafe. Keep corrections clean.
beforeOtherFocus.Leapstrafes: Stay with the leap and read its direction.
beforeOtherFocus.Recovery: Read the change. Reacquire, then settle.
beforeOtherFocus.Spectral Chase: Stay ready for the next strange turn.
beforeOtherFocus.Celestial Chase: Follow the aerial course through every phase.
beforeOtherFocus.Pure Chase: Read each dodge before it happens.
beforeOtherFocus.DotTS: Land close. Confirm. Chain the next flick.
beforeOtherFocus.Vox Pace: Land, finish, transfer. Hold your pace.
beforeOtherFocus.EddieTS: Keep transfers fast and finishes clean.
beforeOtherFocus.PivoTS: Find the next target before the pivot.
beforeOtherFocus.psalmTS: Choose a route and finish each target.
beforeOtherFocus.Vox Blitz: Clear the room in fast bursts.
beforeOtherFocus.Wave Relay: Pass from wave to wave without losing pace.
beforeOtherFocus.Sky Relay: Sweep the sky one target at a time.
beforeOtherFocus.Dev Blitz: Burst through the pack. Find the next clear.

beforeCategory.name: Evasive Switching
beforeCategory.headline: Earn every transfer.
beforeCategory.description: Flick in, match the movement and confirm the kill. Read the next target without abandoning this one. Regeneration tests clean finishes; varied arcs and strafes keep the task about reading, not memorising turns.
